title: 1855 데번의 발굽 자국

images.prompt: Devon, England, February 1855, dawn after a heavy snowfall: the snow-covered thatched roof of an old cottage, along the ridge of the roof runs a single straight line of small horseshoe-shaped hoof prints in the fresh snow, crossing from one end to the other, cold blue dawn light, smoke-less chimney, closed wooden shutters below.

Devon, England, February 1855, dawn after a heavy snowfall: a quiet village of low stone cottages by a misty river estuary seen from a distance, everything buried in white snow, all doors shut, only one window faintly lit, grey-blue sky.

Devon, England, February 1855, dawn after a heavy snowfall: close view of untouched snow on the ground: a single perfectly straight line of small horseshoe-shaped hoof prints, one directly in front of the other, leading away into darkness between bare hedges.

Devon, England, February 1855, dawn after a heavy snowfall: a wide snowy countryside between two distant villages, a single thin straight line of hoof prints crossing the whole white field and continuing over the next hill, bare trees, low cold light.

Devon, England, February 1855, dawn after a heavy snowfall: the top of a tall old stone garden wall covered in snow, a single line of small horseshoe-shaped hoof prints running along the narrow top of the wall; behind it a frozen river and on the far bank the same line of prints continuing.

Devon, England, February 1855, dawn after a heavy snowfall: close view of the round opening of a narrow clay drainpipe, only a hand's width across, half buried in snow at the bottom of a wall; a line of horseshoe-shaped hoof prints leads straight into the pipe opening and stops; the inside of the pipe is pitch black.

Devon, England, February 1855, morning after a heavy snowfall: the closed, bolted wooden front door of a small stone cottage, shutters shut tight, untouched snow piled at the doorstep, a single line of small horseshoe-shaped hoof prints passing right in front of the door, cold grey light, silence.
